verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory-layer platform, and such a product could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent behaviors: outbound webhooks on memory events, memory expiration that stops surfacing items, and automatic graph organization. None of these is a documented way for users to set up autonomous or scheduled automations that run in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
